subject: Mismatch on Marketplace Invoice 6782 — Entity & W-9/W-8 Evidence Needed
messages:
From: CloudBridge Marketplace Finance <invoices@cloudbridge.com>
To: aditya.rao@redwood.ai
Cc: salesops@cloudbridge.com
Date: Mon, 2 Mar 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Invoice 6782 — entity mismatch and tax evidence

Hi Aditya,

We're reconciling March settlements and Invoice 6782 (Marketplace charge for February usage) lists 'Redwood Inference, Inc.' as the billed entity but the W-8/W-9 evidence we have on file is for 'Redwood Labs LLC' (different tax entity). Our finance team needs a signed W-9 or a valid W-8BEN-E (for foreign entities) that exactly matches the legal entity on the invoice to proceed with payment.

Can you confirm which legal entity Redwood wants CloudBridge to pay for marketplace listings (Marketplace co-sell) and provide matching tax forms? If this is a multi-entity pass-through where CloudBridge should bill a reseller entity, please provide the mapping and any DocuSign links for signatures.

Attached: CloudBridge_Invoice_6782.pdf

Thanks,
Maria Garcia
Manager, Marketplace Finance
CloudBridge
[Attachment: CloudBridge_Invoice_6782.pdf (PDF)]
From: aditya.rao@redwood.ai
To: Maria Garcia <maria.garcia@cloudbridge.com>
Cc: vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai, laura.bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 2 Mar 2026 12:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Invoice 6782 — entity mismatch and tax evidence

Hi Maria — thanks for flagging.

Short answer: Redwood Inference wants CloudBridge to route payment to Redwood Inference, Inc. (our US operating entity). The invoice should be aligned to that entity. The W-9 on file was indeed an earlier submission from a reseller trial account (Redwood Labs LLC) — that's our mistake.

I can provide a signed W-9 for Redwood Inference, Inc. and a short reconciliation memo showing the mapping for this invoice (why the older entity shows up). Two quick asks for your team:
1) Can you confirm whether CloudBridge can reissue the invoice to Redwood Inference, Inc. or apply a credit memo and resend a corrected invoice?
2) If your AP requires DocuSign, point me to the link and we will sign immediately.

Looping in Vanessa and Laura from our marketplace/billing team to help with the correct docs.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Strategic Partnerships — Redwood Inference
[Sent from Redwood — quick reply]

Date: Wed, 4 Mar 2026 10:25:00 -07:00
Subject: FW: Invoice 6782 — entity mismatch and tax evidence

Folks — forwarding Maria's note. Quick internal notes:

- Root cause: We onboarded a reseller proof-of-concept last year under Redwood Labs LLC and some legacy marketplace listings routed revenue there. Current policy is to recognize marketplace revenue under Redwood Inference, Inc., but a few listings were never migrated in the marketplace UI.

- Action items for billing:
  * Laura: can we produce a one-page reconciliation (Invoice 6782: original billed to Redwood Labs LLC -> reassign to Redwood Inference, Inc.; show amounts and reason)? Include invoice number, charge line items, and the marketplace transaction id.
  * If CloudBridge cannot reissue, we'll need a credit memo for 6782 and a corrected invoice (target: same amount, new invoice to Redwood Inference, Inc.).
  * Legal/tax: if CloudBridge insists on W-8 vs W-9, we should provide both depending on entity residency. Redwood Inference, Inc. will supply a signed W-9. If CloudBridge needs vendor onboarding for a non-US entity in future, Priyom to prepare W-8BEN-E.

- Timing: aim to have reconciliation + W-9 to Maria by end of week (Fri 6 Mar). If CloudBridge requires DocuSign, we should be ready same day.

Thanks — I'll draft the reconciliation once Laura sends the ledger extract.

—Vanessa
Director, Marketplace Partnerships
Redwood Inference
From: aditya.rao@redwood.ai
To: Maria Garcia <maria.garcia@cloudbridge.com>, invoices@cloudbridge.com
Cc: vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai, laura.bennett@redwood.ai, priyom.das@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 12 Mar 2026 14:05:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Invoice 6782 — entity mismatch and tax evidence (Resolved)

Hi Maria — following up with the fixes and attachments. Thanks for your patience.

Summary of resolution:
- Redwood confirms the billed/legal entity for marketplace charges is: Redwood Inference, Inc., EIN: 12-3456789. Please apply payment to that entity going forward.
- We've attached a signed W-9 for Redwood Inference, Inc. (Redwood_W9.pdf).
- Because the original marketplace transaction was recorded under an earlier reseller test account, we prepared a credit memo and a corrected invoice to be issued to Redwood Inference, Inc. (CreditMemo_6782_reconcile.pdf). If CloudBridge prefers issuing a corrected invoice instead of accepting the credit memo, let us know and we'll coordinate numbers.
- For AP: attached is a short reconciliation memo (included inside the CreditMemo PDF) showing the mapping and the original marketplace transaction id.

Attachments: Redwood_W9.pdf, CreditMemo_6782_reconcile.pdf

Next steps for CloudBridge AP:
1) Confirm receipt of W-9 and credit memo, and whether CloudBridge will reissue Invoice 6782 or apply the credit memo against March settlements.
2) If DocuSign is required, send the link and we'll sign immediately (our DocuSign copies are ready).

If you need any additional tax residency proof (W-8BEN-E) for other entities, Priyom (cc'd) will follow up.

Thanks and apologies for the extra steps — happy to jump on a 15-min call to accelerate.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Strategic Partnerships — Redwood Inference
[Attachments: Redwood_W9.pdf (signed W-9), CreditMemo_6782_reconcile.pdf (reconciliation & credit memo)]
